# Annex D: Debug index {#sec-annex-d-debug-index}

Generated by `tools/validation/gen_debug_index.py`. Do not edit by hand. A debug switch registers under `AEE Debug` and turns the module trace on. A state dump emits one structured line of the module state. A force hook overrides one computed value for a test. The `-` cell means the module has no item in that column.
